visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a bakery display case. Several yellow plastic trays hold white cardboard boxes designed with a pink mascot character face, which has large black eyes and a small mouth. Japanese price tags are visible beneath the trays. The lighting is bright and sterile. (2) The scene shifts to static shots of informative signs posted on a glass window. One sign shows photos of four different types of donuts with Japanese text descriptions. Another sign features a digital clock display showing '14:00' in red numerals. (3) An outdoor shot reveals a line of approximately seven people, including students in school uniforms, waiting in front of a 'Mister Donut' store. The building has a red facade and large glass windows. (4) Inside the store, the camera captures a medium shot of two staff members wearing blue uniforms, caps, and face masks working behind a counter filled with trays of assorted donuts. A female customer with long hair stands at the counter. (5) On a dark brown table, four of the mascot-themed boxes are displayed. They are then opened to reveal four distinct donuts: one covered in white sugar powder, one with a golden-brown kinako dusting, one glazed with a clear syrup, and one topped with a dark purple jam. (6) A close-up shows a person's hands pulling a piece of the glazed donut apart, demonstrating its white, stretchy, and elastic inner texture. The final shot is a medium close-up of a young woman with dark hair in a white shirt taking a bite and closing her eyes with a satisfied expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with high-energy, upbeat electronic pop music featuring bright synthesizer chords and a driving percussive beat. There are no vocals. The spectral profile is bright and clean. (2) A sharp, high-pitched digital 'ding' sound effect triggers, coinciding with a visual cut to a sign. The music continues unabated at a steady tempo. (3) A short digital UI 'click' or 'pop' sound effect occurs as the scene transitions to the storefront. The BGM maintains its high-arousal energy. (4) A melodic 'twinkle' or magic sound effect plays during the shot of the mascot boxes on the table. No ambient environmental noise is audible. (5) A soft, synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the quick cuts showing the different donuts inside the boxes. (6) The video concludes with a final synthesized drum hit that resolves the musical phrase as the woman bites the donut. The overall mix is polished and studio-quality.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to generate excitement and showcase a new, limited-edition product line at Mister Donut in Japan. It uses fast-paced editing and upbeat music to highlight the popularity (the queue), the cute branding (mascot boxes), and the unique physical properties (stretchy texture) of the donuts.
